item.description: ALBAWABA- Israeli forces announced on January 26, 2026, that they had recovered the body of Master Sgt. item.title: Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ teams with Can Evrenol for Disney Plus Dönence
item.description: ALBAWABA - Can Evrenol directs Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ in spy-themed Turkish series for Disney.Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ is getting ready for a new major project.
